confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates made without checking live listings or city-price sources. Restaurant and cafe anchors are the most plausible; hotel, hostel and alcohol anchors are least certain given tourism-driven pricing, Sri Lanka's high alcohol taxes and rupee volatility since 2022. Cocktail and wine anchors are derived from the beer anchor (roughly 2 to 2.3 times beer) because direct local price knowledge is weak. The FX value is the 13 Oct 2026 figure surfaced by search from the RBA overview page; the live RBA table was not opened and no 14 Oct reading was checked.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single city was used. Budget lodging is benchmarked to other South Asian tourist cities such as Kathmandu; restaurant and 3-star tiers are benchmarked to mid-priced Southeast Asian capitals, adjusted upward for Sri Lankan alcohol taxes and Colombo's tourism-driven hotel rates.
